message.subject: Apps Proposal 20 May 2026
message.html:
Hi

 

Thinking about building a new Android or iOS app, or upgrading an existing one?

 

Our India-based team develops custom mobile apps tailored to your goals. We keep things flexible, with rates starting at USD 12 per hour.

 

If you’d like to explore ideas or get a quick estimate, just reply here or share your WhatsApp number and we’ll connect.

 

Best

Kabir .

P.S. Prefer not to hear from us again? Just reply with “NO” in the subject line.
